summary: An entry in the game's journal, given to one player or all players in a dimension. The server holds the quest, its progress and up to 8 objectives, so players who join late or reload still have it. Objectives with a position get a map marker while the quest is tracked. A resource's quests end when it stops, and a player's own quests end when they leave. The event questTrackingChanged(quest, player, tracked) reports tracking.

give.summary: Gives a quest. Throws if one with the same key, dimension and owner exists.

params.key: Your name for it: 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores or dashes.
params.title: The journal title, up to 256 bytes.
params.options: `description`, up to 4096 bytes, keeping line breaks; `type`, 'main', 'side' (default), 'activity', 'event', 'micro' or 'racing'; `objectives`, up to 8, each text or { text, progress, optional, position }; `player`, the one owner, otherwise all players in the dimension; `track`, makes the players follow it; `announce`, default true, shows the game's quest notification.
params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension. By default, all.

give.exampleLua:
local Quest = kcds.characters.Quest

local delivery = Quest.give("deliver_grain", "Grain for the mill", { player = player, description = "The miller in Troskowitz needs three sacks of grain.", objectives = { { text = "Collect the grain", position = kcds.math.Vector3.new(512, 830, 31) }, { text = "Bring it to the miller" } }, track = true })

delivery:setObjective(0, { text = "Collect the grain", progress = "done" })
delivery:setProgress("done")

all.summary: All quests, or those in one dimension.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

all.exampleLua:
for _, quest in ipairs(kcds.characters.Quest.all()) do
  print(quest.key .. ": " .. quest.progress)
end

find.summary: The quest with this key, or null.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.
params.player: Optional: limits it to this owner.

find.exampleLua:
local quest = kcds.characters.Quest.find("deliver_grain", nil, player)
if quest then
  quest:setProgress("done")
end

getById.summary: The quest with this network id, or null.

removeAll.summary: Removes all quests, or those in one dimension, and returns how many.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

exists.exampleLua:
if not quest.exists then
  print("removed")
end

key.summary: The key it was given with.

title.summary: The title. You can assign to it.

description.summary: The description. You can assign to it.

progress.summary: 'active', 'done' or 'failed'. You can assign to it.

player.summary: The owner's network id, or 0 for a quest for the whole dimension.

remove.summary: Removes the quest from all journals.

setProgress.summary: Completes or fails the quest, or makes it active again.

params.announce: Optional: false leaves out the notification.

setObjective.summary: Replaces one objective. An index past the end is ignored.

params.objective: Text or { text, progress, optional, position }.
params.announce: Optional: false leaves out the notification.

setObjective.exampleCs: quest.SetObjective(0, new { text = "Collect the grain", progress = "done" });

params.announce: Optional: false leaves out the notification.

setObjectives.exampleLua: quest:setObjectives({ { text = "Collect the grain", progress = "done" }, { text = "Bring it to the miller", position = kcds.math.Vector3.new(512, 830, 31) } })
setObjectives.exampleCs: quest.SetObjectives(new object[] { new { text = "Collect the grain", progress = "done" }, new { text = "Bring it to the miller", position = new Vector3(512, 830, 31) } });

objectives.exampleLua:
local remaining = {}
for _, objective in ipairs(quest:objectives()) do
  if objective.progress == "active" then
    table.insert(remaining, objective)
  end
end

track.summary: Makes a player, or everyone who has it, follow the quest.

untrack.summary: Makes a player, or everyone, stop following it.
